hook: Your phone screen turns into red, green and blue dots.
title: One Water Drop Shows Your Phone's Pixels
description:
Put a tiny drop of water on your phone screen and look closely. The drop acts like a magnifying lens, so you can see the red, green and blue dots that build every picture. It works on any phone, and you can wipe it off after.

#Shorts #Tech #PhoneTricks
comment_prompt: Did you see the dots? Yes or no
